# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Ohio permits 2,150 MW of gas power for data centers as Rockies Express seeks bids for a new lateral](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 22, 2026. Two Ohio villages, 2,150 MW of new gas-fired power, all of it for data centers. On November 19 the state siting board permitted an 800 MW plant in Ashville and a 1,350 MW plant in Millersport.
- [Downstream: CVR Energy prices $1.25 billion of notes to fund its Marathon refinery purchase](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Midstream: Iranian officials talk of running the US oil blockade as export revenue dries up](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Regulation: Senate passes a broad energy permitting bill, 62 to 33](https://uticamidstream.com/#permitting)
- [Upstream: Nigeria opens registration for a 40 block licensing round](https://uticamidstream.com/#nigeria)
- [Downstream: Thanksgiving gasoline could set a holiday price record despite a month long drop](https://uticamidstream.com/#gasoline)
